deadline.value: Submit by January 15 for full consideration with departmental support; applications are rolling.
deadline.quote: For full consideration with support, submit by January 15 for fall admission.

toefl_min.value: The department expects a TOEFL score of at least 80 from applicants with degrees from non-English-speaking countries.
toefl_min.quote: A minimum TOEFL score of 80 is expected.

supervisor.value: PhD applicants must identify and communicate with a potential advisor before applying.
